# FDG3036

> DO NOT assign type names that would conflict with other types within a single technology.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.4.1.4 Technology Namespace Groups.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

A technology namespace group is all namespaces with the same first two parts (&lt;Company>.&lt;Technology>*), such as Microsoft.Build.Utilities and Microsoft.Build.Tasks.
